known_limitations: The dashboard summarizes a controlled synthetic-damage benchmark rather than real conservation interventions.
Computational flags are review rules and not independent human or conservation ground truth.
Repeated-seed variability is empirical generative uncertainty, not calibrated confidence.
SDXL is a bounded 24-candidate feasibility population, not a full-scope comparison method.
Rendered lightness is an image property, not race, ethnicity or identity.
No combined universal quality or trust score is produced.
origin: Controlled-300 dashboard package built from approved N01–N33, N12A, D01, and D02 evidence
